fichas.title: Renewable Energy Overview
fichas.summary: Overview of renewable energy sources and their conversion into heat, electricity, and fuels; passive, active, and hybrid measures for ecological building technology; and objectives for reducing energy demand and improving energy supply. The page emphasizes matching energy processes to a building project and its location, and checking existing systems for efficiency.
